name: unstructured-data-structuring-profile
purpose: Defines how agents should use AI's strength at turning unstructured or semi-structured inputs into structured records, tables, JSON, requirements, evidence items, tasks, and reviewable knowledge assets.

reader_guide.summary: Use this profile when a task contains messy notes, chat history, documents, PDFs, reviews, research sources, transcripts, screenshots, logs, or mixed-format evidence that should become a reliable structure.
how_to_read: Start with trigger_situations to decide whether structuring is the right move.
Use target_structures to select the output form before extracting facts.
Use structuring_stages to move from messy input to schema, extraction, normalization, validation, and reusable artifact.
Use provenance_contract so each extracted value can be traced back to its source span, file, URL, or observation.
Use validation_contract before treating structured output as factual evidence or automation input.
update_triggers: A repeated task involves turning messy input into requirements, specs, tasks, records, tables, or JSON.
Structured extraction output is used as evidence for a plan, report, evaluation, or automation.
The platform adds a deterministic extractor, schema validator, OCR/document parser, or source normalizer.
New research or tooling changes the best practice for information extraction, document AI, or schema-grounded LLM output.
A structured output causes errors because provenance, null handling, confidence, or validation rules were missing.

structure_rules.rule: Define or select a target schema before extracting values from messy input.
structure_rules.reason: Without a schema, the model may summarize fluently while losing fields, boundaries, units, or null cases.

structure_rules.rule: Every material extracted value should keep a source pointer such as file path, URL, document page, row, timestamp, quoted span, screenshot region, or observation note.
structure_rules.reason: Structured output is useful only when the user can audit where the value came from.

structure_rules.rule: Separate directly extracted values from inferred classifications, summaries, scores, or recommendations.
structure_rules.reason: Facts, model judgments, and derived labels require different confidence and validation treatment.

structure_rules.rule: Represent missing, unknown, ambiguous, conflicting, or not-applicable fields explicitly instead of filling plausible values.
structure_rules.reason: Hallucinated structure is worse than an honest empty field because downstream tools may treat it as data.

structure_rules.rule: Before structured output drives automation, plans, reports, or decisions, validate schema conformance, field coverage, source grounding, contradictions, and sample rows.
structure_rules.reason: AI is good at structuring messy data, but extraction errors can become systematic when reused.

structure_rules.rule: Fields that affect money, legal/medical/safety decisions, public claims, or irreversible actions need human review or stronger independent verification.
structure_rules.reason: Structured output can appear more certain than the evidence supports.

field_guide.meaning: Candidate structured outputs such as JSON, tables, requirements, tasks, evidence items, and decision records.

How extracted values remain traceable to their source.

trigger_situations: The user provides long, messy, or mixed-format text and asks for action.
Chat history should become requirements, specs, tasks, or a decision log.
Research sources should become evidence items, source tables, or citation-backed claims.
Reviews, survey responses, support tickets, interviews, logs, transcripts, or notes should become categories, tags, counts, or patterns.
Documents, PDFs, screenshots, or web pages should become structured records or extraction targets.
A workflow repeats because humans keep manually copying values from messy sources into tables or JSON.

normalization_notes: Keep original value and normalized value when units, dates, names, or categories are transformed.
Do not silently infer missing fields. Add an inference note and support level when a value is derived.

blocking_gaps: claims or numeric values without provenance

quality_risks: bias from extracting only easily visible fields
